title: Polish Medical Visual Question Answering: Vision-Language Models Underutilize Visual Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.12928v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a Polish-language medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmark, built from Polish Board Certification Examination questions for licensed physicians and dentists pursuing specialist certification. The benchmark comprises image-containing questions spanning diverse medical specialties and visual domains, together with a text-only question answering (QA) control set. We evaluate Polish-oriented, general-purpose open-weight, and commercial vision-language models. The task remains challenging: the best model achieves 79.0\% accuracy on the full VQA set, and only GPT-5.6 surpasses the approximate human reference on the subset with available candidate responses; all other evaluated models perform worse than humans. To assess visual grounding, we compare complete inputs with configurations omitting the image, the question, or both, and categorize questions by image importance. translated_title: 波兰语医学视觉问答：视觉语言模型未充分利用视觉证据
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一个波兰语医学视觉问答（VQA）基准，该基准基于波兰委员会认证考试中的问题构建，针对寻求专科认证的执业医师和牙医。该基准包含涵盖多种医学专业和视觉领域的图像相关题目，以及一个纯文本问答（QA）对照组。我们评估了面向波兰语的、通用开放权重的以及商业视觉语言模型。该任务仍具挑战性：最佳模型在完整VQA集上达到79.0%的准确率，且仅GPT-5.6在具有可用候选答案的子集上超过近似人类参考水平；所有其他评估模型表现均不如人类。为评估视觉基础，我们比较了完整输入与省略图像、省略问题或两者均省略的配置，并按图像重要性对问题进行分类。模型从问题中获取的有用信息多于从图像中获取的。
tldr: 本文构建了波兰语医学VQA基准，发现视觉语言模型在医学任务中过度依赖文本而未能充分利用视觉证据，导致性能普遍低于人类。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Polish medical VQA benchmark and reveals that vision-language models over-rely on text while underutilizing visual evidence, resulting in performance below human levels.
